content.contents: static girl, what's your favorite static girl song?
there's a few i like. i think my favorite might be 'to where did all the anime go, static girl?'

i recorded and wrote the whole thing in like 2 hours (maybe the sloppy, thrown-together nature of the track reveals that on its own). it's just a pretty sounding song. i love singing! i love playing guitar! so i want to do more of that. if i have time, maybe you guys'll get more.

another delay on the album's release. it's no longer november but january. it'll be worth it. trust me. it will. i have to keep convincing myself of this too, but it will, it will be worth it, it has to be.
i have things to do over this winter. many things! maybe, you will hear these things.
i hope you're all doing great. things are better for me, or they're getting better. for instance, i have a job now! thank God Almighty.
i needed a fucking job. now i have a FUCKING job!!!!!!!!!! and i am making MONEY!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
and i'm on a weed detox. it kinda sucks but it's worth it to smoke less in future.

i'm tired of living my life in the perception of others and their expectations. i want to be myself. so that's what i'm going to try myself to be. i want to be for me, and for nobody else. i hate living in fear!
in fear of others and what they think! but fuck that. fuck that so much! live for you. live for YOU!
i'm not yet on adderall. still waiting. have to get an ultrasound of my heart. annoying!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
ok guys thats the blog. see u later!
